method.reference: per-pixel, per-calendar-month median and 1.4826 x MAD of VV on the same track, 2020-11-15 to 2024-11-14 (history.py)
method.flood: water, not permanent water, z <= -2 against the seasonal reference, slope under 5 degrees (60 m smoothed GLO-30)
method.floodHaRange: high-confidence flood hectares with the water threshold -1/+1 dB and z <= -2.5/-1.5 (strict, loose)
method.lowConfidence: flood pixels in ESA WorldCover 2021 cropland or wetland that are not connected to Laguna de Bay
method.radarBlind: WorldCover built-up or tree cover without detected open water: unknown
method.barangayFlooded: flood area >= 2.0 ha and >= 3.0x the dry-season noise of the same track
method.opera: NASA OPERA DSWx-S1 v1 (JPL), same pass; open water plus inundated vegetation, outside our permanent water; flagged at >= 2 ha and >= 3x its own dry-season noise
method.nisar: NISAR GCOV HV darkening >= 3 dB against low-lake acquisitions (before 2026-07-31) of the same track; flagged at >= 2 ha and >= 3x the darkening rate more than 2 km from the lake; nearest acquisition within 6 days
method.coherence: ASF HyP3 INSAR_ISCE_MULTI_BURST, consecutive track-32 pairs ending at the pass; built-up pixels -0.2 or more below their dry-season median coherence; flagged at >= 2 ha and >= 3x the same loss on built-up land 2 km inland
method.combined: flooded if any source flags the pass; none seen only if a source looked and none flagged; runs list their sources
